raw_glosses: (history) A coin made of gold or silver, minted at Byzantium and used in currency throughout mediaeval Europe.
glosses: A coin made of gold or silver, minted at Byzantium and used in currency throughout mediaeval Europe.

examples.text: One and All is the motto of the County of Cornwall, used below the coat-of-arms, which is a shield embracing fifteen bezants, or golden roundels, on a black ground; [...].

raw_glosses: (heraldry) A roundel or (that is, a golden circle), the heraldic representation of a gold coin.
glosses: A roundel or (that is, a golden circle), the heraldic representation of a gold coin.
A mass, usually of hair or undigested vegetable matter, found in a human or animal's intestines, similar to a hairball.
